summary.text: Todd Carver is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 95 since January 1, 2025, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Carver served in the U.S. Air Force from 1990 to 1994, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working in law enforcement.
From 2018 to 2022 he held a seat on the Iredell-Statesville Board of Education, District 7.
He succeeded Grey Mills Jr., a fellow Republican, in the House.
